candidate_workaround: Set Python UTF-8 mode before Method Flow summarize so the file-backed summary and console receipt share one encoding envelope.
failure_signature: Method Flow validation passed, but the first summarize process raised UnicodeEncodeError while printing Māori text to the cp1252 console.
recurrence_guard: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 for Method Flow summarize when any retained method contains UTF-8 text.
rollback: Retain the console-encoding failure, preserve the valid ledger, and do not strip or transliterate Māori text.
scope_boundary: Same-owner Method Flow serialization recovery only; no linguistic, cultural, Māori-authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Explicit UTF-8 Method Flow summary envelope
trigger_preconditions: A Method Flow summary contains UTF-8 text and is printed through a Windows console encoding.
